reviews.text: Probably applies to takeaway only. Hate to give bad reviews but I think this one is deserved. I ordered takeaway couple of desserts and when they brought back food- I was told "sorry we don't give ice-cream with takeaway and I don't make rules" and didn't even offer me options to return or money back -so basically I paid 14.40 for small brownie (was dry) and 4 pieces of banana fitters! I asked if I could get extra tofu in miso soup as my child only eats that (while traveling) and person taking ordered seemed lost. And what l got is half a cup of soup with maybe 4 pieces of tofu- but it was delicious. It goes downhill from that- I asked if goyzo can be steamed instead of pan fried (which is standard across world/countries I have tried- and again explained that that is how my child eat it. Anyone who has kids may understand). I was told,"No changes in menu" and he snatched menu and said, "you done ordering "? Oh well. Seat in looked good- and suchi looked good BUT I left felt cheated!

reviews.text: DO NOT GO HERE IF VEGAN! Had a bad experience here. We’re all vegan and ordered “vegan” food off of the menu. 2 of us were served food covered in fish flakes. When we explained we didn’t eat fish and were vegan, we were told it was vegetarian (which is obviously isn’t). We explained it wasn’t and the food was remade but there was still fish flakes on the table after and we were left feeling distrustful and a bit sick. Neither of us could finish our food. When the waitress came to take our plates and ask if it was okay, we explained what had happened and said we weren’t happy, yet we were still charged full price for the meal. We won’t be coming here again and will be getting in touch with customer services.

reviews.author: Sara Maria Andres Hernandez
reviews.text: (Translated by Google) I usually really like ramen, but this one was a huge disappointment. There are tons of TikToks recommending it, but it's all fake advertising. The noodles were undercooked and didn't taste homemade at all. It was like they'd just been taken out of the bag and left on the plate to soak up the broth. The only thing that was good was the broth. The meat was unchewable; it formed two clumps in my mouth that I had to spit out into a napkin. For the price, Lanzhou nearby is a thousand times better—cheaper, and they make the noodles right in front of you; they taste great. (Original) Me gusta mucho el ramen normalmente, y este ha dejado mucho que desear. Hay muchos tiktoks recomendándolo y es mucha publicidad fake. Los fideos están poco hechos, y no saben a caseros. Parece que los hayan sacado de la bolsa y te los hayan dejado en el plato haciéndose con el caldo. Lo único que estaba de locos era el caldo. La carne no se podía masticar, se me hicieron dos bolas en la boca que tuve que escupir en una servilleta. Para el precio mil veces mejor el lanzhou que hay cerca, más barato y hacen los fideos delante de ti, saben muy bien.

reviews.author: Olayanju Biodun
reviews.text: Absolutely loved my experience at Maki & Ramen! The food was genuinely so good. I had the Tantanmen Ramen (I think that’s the name 😂) and it was packed with flavour so, easily one of the nicest ramen dishes I’ve had. Beating the drum every time a customer walks in and they found a table for them is absolutely hilarious and that makes the experience even great. I also tried the mochi ice cream, which was the perfect way to finish the meal. Everything tasted fresh, well prepared and full of flavour. The fact that they have halal options makes it even better. It’s not always easy finding somewhere that offers this kind of Japanese food while also catering to halal diners, so I really appreciated that. Great food, great experience and definitely somewhere I’d happily come back to. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Nikita Patel
reviews.text: Extremely disappointed in the service we received. We had a reservation for 6, it took them such a long time to take our order. Once we ordered our bottle of white wine it took such a long time to come. One of our glasses was cracked and the wine came warm so we sent it back and requested a cold one which took around 30 minutes to come. By this time we were so fed up because NO waiter came to take our order for food or attend to us. The service overall was practically nonexistent. There seemed to be a huge focus on influencers and people filming with cameras, flashlights, and content setups, while our table was repeatedly ignored. It genuinely felt like unless you were there creating content, you weren’t a priority. We had also specifically asked to sit at the bar but were instead given a regular table, despite having a reservation. To make matters worse, the bathrooms were disgusting and clearly had not been maintained. Between the 40-minute wait, cracked glassware, dirty bathrooms, and lack of service, the experience was terrible from start to finish. Would not recommend. DO NOT GO IF YOU AREN’T AN INFLUENCER.
